mentions.name: GoModel
mentions.description: An open-source, self-hosted AI gateway, described as the fastest and most lightweight AI gateway on the market, with a reproducible benchmark comparing it against LiteLLM, Portkey, and Bifrost.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on the last AI gateway you'll ever try - GoModel :)

I recently created a benchmark and it looks like GoModel is the fastest and most lightweight open-source (self-hosted) AI gateway on the market.
